about: The kit's icon subset: Lucide symbols, vendored, never loaded from a remote host. Written by scripts/vendor-icons.mjs from the lucide-static package. A page inlines icons/lucide.svg once (IconSprite.astro) and draws an icon by its id (Icon.astro). Every icon is decoration beside words: it is hidden from assistive technology and never the only label.

source.licence: ISC (Lucide Icons and Contributors), with the MIT licence of Feather (Cole Bemis) for the icons derived from it; both in icons/LICENSE.lucide.txt

icons.arrow-left-right: swap the two councils in compare
icons.arrow-right: a link that goes on to a tool
icons.check: a done or kept state, beside its words
icons.chevron-down: a menu or disclosure that opens
icons.copy: copy a scenario or a table
icons.download: download a PNG or a table
icons.external-link: a link that leaves the site
